summary: Phase 3.7.2 Cmd+K retest after main agent mounted <CommandPalette/> inside AdminOrion. All 6 targeted scenarios pass: (1) Ctrl+K opens overlay [data-testid='orion-cc-palette'] with full-viewport scrim (1920x1080), input auto-focused, default list = exactly 12 items; (2) Typing 'brief' filters list — row-0 = 'Founder Briefing' (Section); ArrowDown moves selection to row-1; Enter on section row closes palette, keeps URL=/admin/orion, and Briefing section becomes active; Enter on prompt row prefills + sends 'Give me a founder briefing' to Orion Chat (verified via reply rendered with Growth/Activity blocks); (3) Escape closes palette; (4) Scrim click (outside card) closes palette; (5) Mobile 390x844: palette opens via dispatched event, card width=366.6px (~94vw), input is tappable and filters; (6) Admin Hub regression: founder sees admin-hub-card-orion with 'Founder Only' badge + '✦ Open Orion Command Center' footer, clicking navigates to /admin/orion; support_admin does NOT see the Orion card. The previously CRITICAL bug is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrion.jsx:140-151 — Ctrl+K keydown listener still attached at window level WITHOUT input/textarea focus check. Pressing Ctrl+K while typing in Orion Chat textarea will still toggle the palette and preventDefault. Add `if (['INPUT','TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName) && !document.activeElement?.dataset?.testid?.startsWith('orion-cc-palette')) return;` if E1 wants palette to respect typing context. Low priority — current behavior is acceptable for a power-user shortcut.

AdminOrion.jsx:1097 CommandPalette — input ref focus delay is 30ms inside setTimeout; works but the small race produces a flash where the scrim mounts before the input grabs focus. Consider `requestAnimationFrame(() => inputRef.current?.focus())` for snappier UX. Cosmetic only.

AdminOrion.jsx:1109 — Filter is case-insensitive substring on label OR group; works as expected. Note that querying 'brief' returns 'Founder Briefing' (section) at index 0 and 'Give me a founder briefing' (Investor prompt) at index 1, matching the requirement.
AdminOrion.jsx:1122 scrim onClick — uses simple `onClick={onClose}` on scrim with `onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}` on card. Correct pattern, verified by 'scrim click closes palette' test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 scenarios; 20/21 raw assertions — 1 false negative due to post-submit textarea clear, visual evidence confirms prefill worked)
